Class Cannon

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.Component
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.Cannon
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Cannon extends Component
Represents a Cannon component with configurable power and orientation. The Cannon can calculate firepower based on its type and position. The class supports single-power and multi-power cannons. The class extends the Component base class.
